resourceListPageBlock.title: Resource List Page
resourceListPageBlock.description: The standard Sidebar Basic application layout with its project overview replaced by a controlled resource DataTable.
resourceListPageBlock.guidanceBody: Connect resources and action callbacks to your application, then replace the example navigation values and project sections with real routes. Use stable workspace IDs, and pass loading, server-query, and table configuration through tableProps. The Block preserves the Sidebar Basic shell and swaps only the overview content for ResourceListTable.
